summary: The United States completed mine-clearing operations in the Strait of Hormuz, reopening international shipping lanes blocked by Iranian mines. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei urged Gulf states to unite against the US and Israel, while US military leaders warned that extending the war in Iran is unsustainable due to depleted forces. Hamas's senior spokesperson Abu Ubaida was killed, and the IDF eliminated multiple Hamas operatives in Gaza.
key_points: The US military completed systematic mine-clearing in the Strait of Hormuz, removing Iranian mines from international shipping lanes and reopening transit for oil tankers (Source: @mamlekate/104267).

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei urged Gulf and Muslim rulers to unite and establish joint defenses against the US and Israel, accusing them of seeking to divide Muslim countries (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6620).

US military leaders warned Defense Secretary Hegseth that extending the war in Iran is unsustainable, with ships, missiles, drones, and air defense systems depleted, and only a quarter of destroyers ready for deployment (Source: @naya_foriraq/88762).
Hamas's senior military spokesperson Abu Ubaida was killed on day 242 of the Al-Aqsa Flood operation, with Hudayfa al-Khulut named as his successor (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387623).
The IDF killed Hamas militants in Deir al-Balch in central Gaza and two Nukhba operatives in Khan Younis in southern Gaza, citing prevention of imminent attacks (Source: @yediotnews25/134442).
Iran's acting defense minister stated the country will unveil new military surprises in due time amid ongoing conflict (Source: @presstv/204751).
The IRGC's Unit 4000 uses Telegram to build overseas networks, targeting recruits with crypto payments before directing them toward intelligence gathering and sabotage (Source: @shin_persian/9200).

sections.executive_summary: The United States completed mine-clearing operations in the Strait of Hormuz, reopening a critical global energy corridor blocked by Iranian mines. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei called on Gulf states to unite against the US and Israel, while US military leaders warned that extending the war in Iran is unsustainable due to severely depleted forces. Hamas's senior spokesperson Abu Ubaida was killed, and the IDF continued eliminating Hamas operatives across the Gaza Strip.
iran: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei urged Gulf and Muslim rulers to unite and establish joint defenses against what he called their real enemy, accusing the US and Israel of seeking to divide Muslim countries across West Asia and the Persian Gulf (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6620).
Iran's acting defense minister stated the country will unveil new military surprises in due time, signaling continued escalation amid the ongoing conflict (Source: @presstv/204751).

Iranian government sources reported the dispatch of popular forces to the Strait of Hormuz in response to Trump's threats, heightening tensions at this critical chokepoint (Source: @VahidOnline/78083).

The IRGC's Unit 4000 uses Telegram to build overseas networks, targeting potential recruits with cryptocurrency payments before directing them toward intelligence gathering and sabotage operations (Source: @shin_persian/9200).

US military leaders warned that extending the war in Iran could put US forces worldwide under significant pressure, with ships, missiles, drones, and air defense systems depleted, and only about a quarter of destroyers ready for deployment (Source: @naya_foriraq/88762).

The US military confirmed that over 200 mine-like objects were examined in the Strait of Hormuz, with a smaller number confirmed as actual mines cleared by Navy divers, SEALs, aircraft, and support equipment (Source: @mamlekate/104267).

Two Israeli minors aged 14 and 16 from Kiryat Motzkin were indicted for spying for Iran, including photography missions, graffiti, and recruiting additional minors for the agent (Source: @amitsegal/64345).
israel: The IDF killed Hamas militant Hassan Asam Hussein Nassir in Deir al-Balch in central Gaza Strip, stating he was advancing terror plans against IDF forces and Israeli civilians, using precision munitions and aerial surveillance to minimize civilian harm (Source: @yediotnews25/134442).

The IDF killed two Hamas Nukhba operatives, Yasser Abu al-Khair and Mohammed al-Din, in Khan Younis in southern Gaza Strip, accusing them of advancing attacks and attempting to restore Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire agreement (Source: @idf_telegram/25014).

The Israeli military issued a military order seizing more than 37 dunams of land in Beitunya west of Ramallah, which Hamas condemned as a new confirmation of ongoing land theft and settlement policies (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387621).

An attempted assassination occurred in Rahat when masked individuals opened fire at point-blank range into a young man's vehicle, critically wounding him; police opened an investigation into the attempted killing (Source: @pkpoi/143773).
gaza_west_bank: Hamas's senior military spokesperson Abu Ubaida was killed on day 242 of the Al-Aqsa Flood operation, with Hudayfa al-Khulut named as his successor in a farewell address (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387623).

Palestinian militant Hassan Nassir was killed in an Israeli strike targeting a group of citizens near Ein al-Balak bakery on Ein al-Balak Street west of Deir al-Balch city in the Gaza Strip (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387591).

Two additional members of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force were killed in an Israeli strike in Khan Younis in southern Gaza Strip, identified as Yasser Abu al-Khair and Mohammed al-Din (Source: @manniefabian/59065).

The Israeli military seized more than 37 dunams of land in Beitunya west of Ramallah in the West Bank, which Hamas condemned as part of an imperialist settlement plan with no legitimacy (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387621).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran is actively escalating multiple fronts simultaneously, deploying popular forces to the Strait of Hormuz while its Supreme Leader calls for regional unity against the US and Israel. The IRGC's Unit 4000 continues overseas recruitment and sabotage operations via encrypted platforms. Iran's acting defense minister has signaled further military surprises, and the country's mine-laying in the Strait of Hormuz represents a significant threat to global energy security. The US military warns that force depletion from the Iran conflict is compromising readiness worldwide.
sections.regional_response: The United States has conducted a successful mine-clearing operation in the Strait of Hormuz, with Central Command confirming international routes are now free of Iranian mines and shipping traffic recovering. Iran's Supreme Leader has called on Gulf states to unite against the US and Israel, potentially fracturing Gulf cooperation. US military leaders have formally warned that extending the war in Iran is unsustainable, with the Navy reporting only a quarter of destroyers ready for deployment, signaling growing internal US pressure against escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's Unit 4000 has been identified as operating Telegram-based overseas recruitment networks using cryptocurrency payments to target potential recruits for intelligence gathering and sabotage, representing a persistent asymmetric threat. The US military's successful mine-clearing in the Strait of Hormuz demonstrates significant undersea operational capability. Israeli intelligence operations against Iranian espionage networks domestically continue, with two minors indicted for spying for Iran. Hamas's loss of its senior spokesperson Abu Ubaida may disrupt command communications but the organization continues military operations in Gaza.
